takes.p: Every Friday the Archive adds one long piece: a writer, an imprint, an artist or a format, written for people who already own too many books. Corrections are welcome and acted on. If you know something we got wrong, the address is at the bottom of every page.

The best rule I know for building a collection is the plainest. Buy the books you will actually open again. Investment talk comes and goes, but a shelf of books you love is never a bad position, whatever the listings say this year.

Dealers know things that never make it into a listing: where a copy came from, what else came with it, which printings they have seen fake. Most of them like to talk about it. Ask, listen, and buy something. That conversation is half of what this hobby is for.
